QuestInfo.name: The Forbidden Book of Alchemy
QuestInfo.0: The Forbidden Book of Alchemy has been stolen. What could have happened? Ask #p2159319# for details.
QuestInfo.1: The Forbidden Book of Alchemy was split in half, with each group, Zenumist and Alcadno, taking half. The Zenumists have lost their half, so check on the half belonging to the Alcadno. Visit #b#p2159320##k, the president of #b#m261000000#'s#k #bAlcadno Association#k, and ask him about it.
QuestInfo.2: You were too late. #p2159320# handed over the other half of the #t04032975# to suspicious magicians who hypnotized him. #p2159320# told you that Dark Alchemy is not used for attacking or defending, but rather for making or destroying magical substances. In any event, who were those magicians...?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 112,999
Can proceed to The Chase and the Conspiracy

0.0: And how did YOU know about the Forbidden Book of Alchemy, anyway?\r\n#L0##bI seek relics of the Black Mage, and destroy them. Rumors of Dark Alchemy are common enough, and I followed them here. Now, tell me what happened to the book.#l\n#k
0.1: Those...people...stole it. I don't know who they are, but their magic was strong enough to stun me, open the safe, and escape with the book. However, we only had half of the book. The Alcadno have the other half...but if the thieves get theirs as well, they will gain access to Dark Alchemy...\r\n#L0##bThe other half?#l\n#k
0.2: We tried to protect the world from Dark Alchemy by splitting the book in half. Each half is meaningless without the other. Giving one half to both Zenumists and Alcadnos seemed logical...at least until now.\r\n#L0##bThen, we must ensure the other half is secure!#l\n#k
0.3: Indeed! You'll find the other half with #p2159320#. I wonder if the thieves have found #p2159320# yet... You must hurry! Stop them, if you can!

yes.0: Hurry to the Alcadno association, and see if the #t04032975# is safe. I'll take care of matters here, and join you when I can. Check with the president of Alcadno, #b#p2159320##k.

no.0: What, now all of a sudden, you don't care? What kind of a hero ARE you?

1.0: Wha... No! What have I done? Where is the Forbidden Book of Alchemy? Did I...give it to those strange magicians? I did! Blast their foul hypnotism! I should have...wait, who in the world are you?!\r\n#L0##bThat is not important! The #p2159319# half has been stolen already, has it? I need details on this Dark Alchemy they're after. Tell me!#l\n#k
1.1: Oh... This is terrible. They had the other half, too. That means they have the complete book... We're doomed. Fine, I might as well tell you what you want.

yes.0: Dark Alchemy is not used for attacking or defending, but rather for making or destroying magical substances. It can alter the very flow of the world's magic!
yes.1: Please, you MUST return the book to us! It is too dangerous in the hands of madmen. I'll get you a #t04032974# to chase after them with. Give me a moment...

npc.0: Hurry! Find the president of Alcadno, #b#p2159320##k.
